name: How much does a workplace harassment attorney cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a workplace harassment attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a workplace harassment attorney can vary. Many attorneys offer initial consultations for free or a reduced fee to discuss your case. For representation, some attorneys work on a contingency fee basis, meaning their fee is a percentage of any settlement or award you receive, and you pay nothing upfront. Others may charge hourly rates or flat fees depending on the services. It's crucial to discuss fee structures clearly during your initial consultation so you understand all potential costs involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Attorney costs vary; many offer free initial consultations. Fees often operate on a contingency basis (percentage of award) or hourly rates. Discuss fees clearly upfront.
